_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Structural BTC momentum and ETF flows support a push toward the final Euphoria rung, but the analyst's high-trust divergence read (VIX, gold, Fed liquidity) means this leg up is conditional on macro risk signals compressing rather than a base-case extrapolation.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both point UP, but the analyst conditions the move on Fed liquidity expansion and VIX compression while the narrative treats it as a more natural trend continuation.
next_move.confirmed_if: fed_liquidity rises above 15 + stablecoin_growth recovers above 60 + VIX compresses below 50
next_move.invalidated_if: gold_strength stays pinned above 95 + VIX spikes above 75 + exchange_netflow turns positive with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d climbing above 95
